mapper.select: SELECT id, name, username, password, phone, sex, id_number, status, create_time, update_time, create_user, update_user FROM employee WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee ( id, name, username, password, phone, sex, id_number, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{username}, #{password}, #{phone}, #{sex}, #{idNumber}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.update: UPDATE employee SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
